title: UE-requested PDU session release procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure not accepted
entities.description: Procedure triggered when the network rejects a UE's request to release a PDU session. The SMF sends a PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message with a 5GSM cause indicating the rejection reason.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request release of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the SMF to reject a PDU session release request, containing a 5GSM cause IE indicating the rejection reason.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejecting the PDU session release. Common values include #35 (PTI already in use), #43 (Invalid PDU session identity), and #95-111 (protocol errors).

entities.name: T3582
entities.description: Timer running in the UE during the PDU session release procedure. Stopped upon receipt of a PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity allocated for the PDU session release procedure. Released by the UE upon receipt of a PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Identity of the PDU session being released.

entities.name: SMF does not accept the request
entities.description: Condition where the SMF decides not to accept the UE's request to release the PDU session.

entities.name: Locally release PDU session
entities.description: Action performed by the UE to locally release the PDU session upon receipt of a PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message.

entities.name: Locally leave MBS multicast sessions
entities.description: Action performed by the UE to locally leave any associated MBS multicast sessions when the PDU session is released.

relations.description: The procedure is triggered when the SMF does not accept the PDU session release request.
The procedure includes the SMF creating and sending a PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message.
The PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message contains the 5GSM cause IE indicating the rejection reason.
Receipt of the PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message causes the UE to stop timer T3582.
Receipt of the PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message causes the UE to release the allocated PTI value.
Receipt of the PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message causes the UE to locally release the PDU session.
Local release of the PDU session causes the UE to locally leave any associated MBS multicast sessions.
